derivation: Initial observational allowances retain the historical Phase 0 64 MiB RSS and two-descriptor allowances. The Phase 1 warm baseline must be measured after the complete mixed cycle; no historical RSS value is reused as this node's baseline.
limitations: Finite runs do not prove leak freedom, arbitrary-duration fairness or an SLO. Every full run must satisfy the fixed allowance; violations require investigation rather than retroactive threshold changes. Smoke runs do not calibrate reclamation.
